defects.summary: ARC-0095 is absent, so the declared generic MCP-host set cannot be enumerated without invention.
TST-0049 has no receipt, so no client has an executed compatibility-matrix conformance run.
Codex CLI 0.147.0 is installed but has no receipt proving a plugin-owned hook fired or command resolved inside that client.
The implementation gate accepts self-asserted RUN evidence tied to an unrelated receipt, does not bind qualifying objects to TST-0049, and does not enforce the complete declared-client set.
Harvest listed 23 sidecar paths as exists:true; independent python Path.is_file and PowerShell Test-Path both find 0 of 23 on this worktree. Rows dropped because artifact.exists is const true.
Harvest Linux availability is stale: claude 2.1.228 and agy 1.1.13 are PRESENT on this box. Presence is not RUN evidence.
Harvest condition-11 first-red BLD-0023/P13 is stale. P13 exists (25211 B). Live --check first-red is BLD-0024 refute-report.txt.
